name: 端到端：F88 套图审核 5个编辑操作 → 逐个下载验证
description: 进入套图审核详情（taskNamePattern含'套图审核'），依次对套图中不同图片执行5个编辑操作（局部修改/替换/裁剪/高清化/负反馈），每个操作后验证下载得到编辑后数据。套图审核无驳回按钮。

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]')); const setTask = rows.find(r => r.innerText && r.innerText.includes('套图审核')); const row = setTask || rows[0]; return row ? { taskId: row.getAttribute('data-row-key'), isSetImage: row.innerText.includes('套图') } : null; })()
steps.description: 找到套图审核任务并读取ID
断言目标为套图审核任务

steps.label: f88-set-image-initial
steps.description: 截图-套图审核初始状态

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img')).filter(i => i.src && i.src.includes('scene-ossgw') && i.getBoundingClientRect().width > 50); return { imageCount: imgs.length, urls: imgs.slice(0, 5).map(i => i.src.substring(0, 80)) }; })()
steps.description: 记录套图图片列表（多张）

steps.expression: (() => { const actionItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const swapBtn = actionItems.find(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); const aria = i.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''; return (img && img.alt === '替换') || aria === 'swap' || i.querySelector('[class*=anticon-swap]'); }); if(swapBtn) { const wrapper = swapBtn.closest('[class*=imageActions]'); if(wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; swapBtn.click(); return 'clicked swap'; } return 'not found'; })()
steps.description: 【操作1-替换】hover第1张图→点击替换按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const actionItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const cropBtn = actionItems.find(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); return img && img.alt === '裁剪'; }); if(cropBtn) { const wrapper = cropBtn.closest('[class*=imageActions]'); if(wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; cropBtn.click(); return 'clicked crop'; } return 'not found'; })()
(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /确\s*定/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked confirm crop';} return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const actionItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const hdBtn = actionItems.find(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); return img && img.alt === '高清化'; }); if(hdBtn) { const wrapper = hdBtn.closest('[class*=imageActions]'); if(wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; hdBtn.click(); return 'clicked hd'; } return 'not found'; })()
steps.description: 【操作3-高清化】点击高清化按钮

steps._comment: ===== 操作4/5: 局部修改 → 下载验证 =====

steps.expression: (() => { const actionItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const editBtn = actionItems.find(i => i.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'edit' || i.querySelector('[class*=anticon-edit]')); if(editBtn) { const wrapper = editBtn.closest('[class*=imageActions]'); if(wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; editBtn.click(); return 'clicked local-modify'; } return 'not found'; })()

(() => { const input = document.querySelector('.ant-modal textarea, .ant-modal input[type=text]'); if(input) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value')?.set || Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value')?.set; setter.call(input, '调整图片布局'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'filled prompt'; } return 'no input'; })()

(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal button')).find(b => /确\s*定/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked confirm';} return 'no btn'; })()

steps.description: 【操作4-局部修改】点击下载验证

steps.label: f88-set-op4-local-modify
steps.description: 截图-套图局部修改操作

steps.expression: (() => { const actionItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const fbBtn = actionItems.find(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); return img && (img.alt === '负反馈' || img.src.includes('negative')); }); if(fbBtn) { const wrapper = fbBtn.closest('[class*=imageActions]'); if(wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; fbBtn.click(); return 'clicked feedback'; } return 'not found'; })()
steps.description: 【操作5-负反馈】点击负反馈按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const options = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal .ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-modal .ant-radio-wrapper')); if(options.length > 0) { options[0].click(); return 'selected option'; } return 'no options'; })()

(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal button')).find(b => /确\s*定|提\s*交/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked submit';} return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /确\s*认/.test(b.textContent) && b.className && b.className.includes('primary')); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked confirm';} return 'no btn'; })()

steps.label: f88-set-image-e2e-done
steps.description: 截图-套图5操作端到端完成

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在待审核套图审核任务（taskName含'套图审核'）。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 套图审核使用SetImageReview组件，含8按钮（无驳回）；每张图片有独立工具栏（hover显示）；5个编辑操作：局部修改/替换/裁剪/高清化/负反馈；每个操作后验证下载。
riskPoints: 套图审核任务可能不存在（需构造套图链路数据）
套图中多张图片需分别hover触发各自工具栏
高清化和局部修改为异步操作，需等待结果
负反馈可能触发重生，等待时间不确定
